about.text: France’s plain cream, at least 30 % fat: sold as crème fraîche fluide when it is only pasteurised, for in France crème fraîche need not be soured; only the épaisse, thick, kind is.

links.name: French Ministry of the Economy: laits et crèmes

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Crème fluide is whole cream left liquid: separated, standardised to 30 % or more and heated. Lactic ferments are what make the thick kind (crème épaisse); thickness and fat are separate properties.

steps.note: Pasteurised at this heat, or UHT at 150 °C, or sterilised (non-UHT) at 115 °C.
